name: smwgraphics-touhou-koumakyou-the-embodiment-of-scarlet-devil-spellcard-remilia-scarlet
title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil - Spellcard (Remilia Scarlet)
description:
Here's the BG from Touhou 6. Sure, it's also seen in Stage 6, but this BG is used as spellcard effect by Remilia Scarlet. This was just as hard as Touhou Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night - Stage 6B (Outside), if not harder. This BG was not only harder to reduce tiles, but I had to remove the 'black' pixels, in order to conserve tile space. This does use the bushes, diagonal pipes and part of the fence tiles. The rest can be used.
No credit required.
